cutoff_safety_routes.route_A: ChEMBL_34 (pre-2024-06-01) from an official/mirrored archive, checksum-verified, license quoted (CC BY-SA 3.0)
cutoff_safety_routes.route_B_fallback: mechanism links reconstructed solely from ChEMBL_37 mechanism records supported by >=1 PubMed reference with publication year <= 2024 (NCBI-resolved), or molecule first_approval <= 2023; molecules lacking cutoff-era evidence excluded from clusters
cutoff_safety_routes.route_fail: if neither route works: retain bounded cohort, stop predictive mechanism work, report

folds: temporal: development = R1 cohort evidence as of cutoff; validation = post-cutoff events; cluster-preserving assignment (all trials of a mechanism cluster in the same fold)

gates.G1_cutoff_safety: route A or route B demonstrably satisfied with evidence ledger (checksums/license or PMID-year resolution log); ChEMBL_37-only content excluded from cutoff facts
gates.G2_drugmap_coverage: FROZEN METRICS (locked before recomputation): primary = >=60% of names appearing in >=2 cohort trials mapped AND >=80% trial-weighted mapping over the same pool; per-phase floors = >=50% (names-in->=2-trials) AND >=70% trial-weighted within each phase stratum (Phase 1/2/3/4; smaller strata reported without floor); per-disease-strata floors = >=50% (names-in->=2-trials) within each of the top-10 most frequent MeSH browse condition terms having >=1000 cohort trials (strata frozen here as data-driven top-10, listed in results before recomputation); unmapped names form an explicit abstain stratum, reported, never dropped
gates.G3_conditions: eligibility/condition features via MeSH browse OR frozen cutoff free-text normalization (normalizer + vocabulary sha256 frozen before use); MeSH-only coverage 84.33% reported separately as R1 diagnostic
gates.G4_clusters: mechanism cluster = (cutoff-safe mapped molecule -> mechanism target set) x (normalized condition); cluster IDs + mapping tables frozen with sha256 BEFORE validation open; cluster build log records cutoff-safe evidence per molecule
gates.G5_freeze: cluster IDs, mappings, vocab hash frozen with timestamp logged BEFORE first 2026-06-01 fetch
gates.G6_linkage: 0 post-cutoff dates in cutoff features (row-level audit); 0 duplicate NCTs across folds; >=100 typed validation events among cohort between 2024-06-01 and 2026-06-01; retraction/publication linkage = evidence flags only
gates.G7_model: unchanged from R1 lock: run only if G1-G6 pass; frozen logistic + mechanistic ranking must beat base-rate and logistic on PR-AUC, lift@50 >=1.5x base rate, ECE <=0.05 temporal holdout; abstention coverage + label-noise sensitivity reported; any failure -> bounded product, no ranking claims

invariants.abstained_classes: safety + regulatory-hold stay abstained; no third coder; modeling uses only reliability-qualified classes
invariants.cohort_labels: R1 frozen cohort (123,697 NCTs) and reliability-filtered labels are development evidence only; never recomputed; validation snapshot 2026-06-01 stays unopened until G5 freeze completes
scope: no inferring failure from absent results

project: SP-006 (DOC-2-069), Round 2: mapping/reliability refinement + cluster freeze + gated modeling
